name: ecovisarjan
description: EcoVisarjan: guiding Ganesh idol immersion and festival waste to safer, designated options in Hyderabad.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n api,web,ml -c red,yellow,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run ml:dev"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
